references.text: Psalm 22:1 mentions a feeling of abandonment that can be associated with the darkness and forsakenness Jesus experienced on the cross.
Jeremiah 15:9 describes a situation where day turns to night, which can be seen as a parallel to the darkness that covered the land.
Genesis 1:3 speaks of the creation of light, contrasting with the darkness that fell over the land.
Amos 8:9 prophesies a time when day will turn to night, which can be seen as a prediction of the darkness during the crucifixion.
Revelation 8:12 describes a third of the sun being struck, which may symbolize the darkness that occurred.
